method.reference_comparison: Each window is comparable only when candidate and reference actual_start and actual_end match exactly. Relations describe historical return/drawdown only; they are neither alpha nor a recommendation.
method.scope: Only pipeline-classified debt_mixed shares; pure-bond strategies are excluded.

limitations: Report-period holdings can change after disclosure; actual equity buckets are not forward-looking risk labels.
